written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as Colette Kress takes over as interim chief
written.summary: NVIDIA co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following an admission regarding a personal relationship, with CFO Colette Kress appointed interim CEO. The leadership change has triggered market concerns and raised questions about the company's future strategy on open-source AI and international projects.

written.headline: Arm shares fall 6.5% as Nvidia board considers CEO Rene Haas
written.summary: Arm Holdings shares fell 6.5% after reports that Nvidia's board approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang. The search adds uncertainty to the semiconductor sector following Huang's departure from Nvidia.

written.headline: MeitY opens DPDP Act consent manager registration portal
written.summary: MeitY launched an online portal for companies to register as consent managers under the DPDP Act, 2023, requiring a minimum net worth of ₹2 crore. The framework came into effect on November 13, 2026.
